## Session host compliance
Latest daily evidence from each host (`Write-ComplianceEvidence.ps1`): deferred STIG step, registry and security template settings, AppLocker enforcement, Defender status and optional SCAP results. This is configuration evidence for review; it is not an authorization decision.

content.query:
AvdComplianceEvidence_CL
| where Computer startswith "__HOST_PREFIX__"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, Source, Item, RuleId
| summarize Checks = count() by Status
content.title: Checks by status

content.query:
AvdComplianceEvidence_CL
| where Computer startswith "__HOST_PREFIX__"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, Source, Item, RuleId
| summarize Failing = countif(Status in ("Fail", "Error")), Checks = count(), LastRun = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| where Failing > 0
| order by Failing desc
content.title: Hosts not fully passing

content.query:
AvdComplianceEvidence_CL
| where Computer startswith "__HOST_PREFIX__"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, Source, Item, RuleId
| where Status in ("Fail", "Error")
| project Computer, Source, RuleId, Item, Expected, Actual, Status, TimeGenerated
| order by Computer asc, Source asc
content.title: Failing checks

content.query:
let reporting = AvdComplianceEvidence_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d) | distinct Computer;
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and Computer startswith "__HOST_PREFIX__"
| distinct Computer
| where Computer !in (reporting)
content.title: Hosts without evidence in 2 days

content.query:
Event
| where Computer startswith "__HOST_PREFIX__" and Source == "Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker"
| summarize Events = count() by Computer, EventID, EventLevelName
| order by Events desc
content.title: AppLocker blocks and audit hits

content.query:
Event
| where Computer startswith "__HOST_PREFIX__" and Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, EventLevelName, RenderedDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Defender detections and changes
